ruling.scope: Ben approved PR 245 on 2026-09-05, in his words: "Approve". This is the FIRST use of the pin-manifest review door that PR 249 added, merged to main as dba60d3d. Its declared sites had drifted from the built artifacts, so assertion 269 failed and blocked four pull requests. This corrects the declared sites to match. I verified the merge-base and the blob digest on disk before writing this record.
